facts.fact: Fraternité Matin reports that ST Digital officially inaugurated a new-generation data centre in the VITIB technology free zone at Grand-Bassam on 2 October 2025, which its Côte d'Ivoire director general said lets Ivorian companies and institutions host their data in the country.
